title: stage-back runs an item's checks before the staged file is committed, so a check that measures a clone of HEAD sees the old file
goal: stage-back runs an item's own checks over a commit that holds the copies (undone when a check fails), or names the checks that read a clone of HEAD and leaves them to done

run: import inspect,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_dispatch as d; s=inspect.getsource(d.cmd_stage_back); assert s.index('commit_message(') < s.index('stage_back_checks('), 'stage-back checks the item before it commits the copies'
